# bratuka.dev
> Personal portfolio and project hub for BrAtUkA.

BrAtUkA is a computer-science student and developer in Islamabad, PK, building local-first software, reverse-engineering useful systems, and creating 3D art.

Topics: Rust / Tauri, Python, TypeScript, C# / .NET, Reverse Engineering, AI / ML, Local-First Software, Blender / 3D.

## Tools and Web Apps
- [PDF Dark Mode Converter](https://bratuka.dev/pdf-dark-mode-converter/) - Privacy-first, browser-native PDF theming with 16+ themes, GPU acceleration, offline processing, and no file uploads.

## Featured Public-Source Projects
- [PDF Dark Mode Converter](https://github.com/BrAtUkA/pdf-dark-mode-converter) - Browser-native PDF theming tool. Source available under the PolyForm Noncommercial licence.
- [KnoxHybrid Monitor](https://github.com/BrAtUkA/knoxhybrid-monitor) - Rust and Tauri system-tray app that periodically monitors Knox solar-inverter data. Open source under the MIT licence.
- [spoti2yt](https://github.com/BrAtUkA/spoti2yt) - Windows tray app for bidirectional Spotify and YouTube track or playlist conversion. Source available under the PolyForm Noncommercial licence.
- [ComicK Revive](https://github.com/BrAtUkA/ComicK-Revive) - Chromium reading extension with a multi-source catalog, offline caching, library, history, and position resume. Source available under the PolyForm Noncommercial licence.
- [Computer-Use Agent](https://github.com/BrAtUkA/Computer-Use-Agent) - Experimental local VLM-powered computer-control agent with publicly viewable source.
- [NetGuard](https://github.com/BrAtUkA/NetGuard) - Semester-project network IDS using XGBoost, anomaly and behavioral detection, MITRE ATT&CK mapping, and a forensics dashboard. Open source under the MIT licence.
